# Samparka

> White-label loyalty platform for restaurants, cafés, and salons in Nepal and India.

Samparka helps businesses run branded customer loyalty programs via NFC tap, QR codes, or WhatsApp — no app download required for customers.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://samparka.co/): Product overview
- [Blog](https://samparka.co/blog): Case studies and guides

## Case studies
- [Caffeophilia](https://samparka.co/blog/caffeophilia-case-study): 30% repeat visit increase
- [TheNewBarber](https://samparka.co/blog/thenewbarber-digital-loyalty-grooming-success): 45% revenue growth
- [Cinnamon Garden](https://samparka.co/blog/cinnamon-garden-loyalty-case-study)
- [Mira Boulangerie](https://samparka.co/blog/mira-boulangerie-loyalty-case-study)
